newsitem.title: USA: Forcenergy reserves boosted by find.
newsitem.headline: Forcenergy reserves boosted by find.

text.p: Forcenergy Inc said Tuesday a successful exploratory well has been drilled on the company's High Island A-470 lease block which is expected to add 17.5 billion cubic feet to the company's proven reserves.
The well, located offshore eastern Texas, logged pay in one shallow and two deeper horizons, Forcenergy said, adding it is being drilled deeper to evaluate a remaining exploratory zone.

The company said it plans to install a small platform and process production from this discovery at its existing High Island A-467 facilities. Initial production from the discovery well is expected to begin in early 1998 at net rates of 10 to 15 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.

The company said two unsuccessful exploitation wells have been drilled in its South Marsh Island 136/137 complex off Louisiana using the same wellbore. A third well is being drilled which also uses the wellbore.
Forcenergy said it plans to drill four to six additional wells in the field during the next 12 months.
